environment.description: Node.js 18 Apollo Server v4 deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 directly to the container on port 4000. No request filtering or mutation inspection is configured. The rendered HTML pages are served to browsers with no Content-Security-Policy header. Browsers will load scripts from any origin specified in src attributes.

config.sri_enforcement: none - browser loads any script regardless of integrity mismatch when no require-sri-for directive
